ladder.label: NEARING A LOW
ladder.why: Mixed structure. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Watch the 10-day average and cycle-day count.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum positive; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 30 · failed · daily cycle day 25).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a low. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: A normal mid-cycle dip below the 10-day average — the real cycle low isn't due for ~11+ trading days. Wait for support to hold, or for the next low to set up.
entry.text_zh: 这是跌破 10 日均线的正常周期中段回调——真正的周期低点要到约 11+ 个交易日后才会到来。等待支撑站稳，或等下一个低点构筑成形。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 25 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 25 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 30 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 30 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 结构混合。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 关注 10 日均线与周期天数。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为正；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）；投资者周期已逾期；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 30 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期第 25 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近低点。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
上一周期见顶偏早（趋势走弱的暗示）
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ NEARING A LOW signal triggered 1 trading day ago (~2026-06-17), switching from UPTREND. Signal strength: faint (score +0/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 接近低点信号于 1 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-17），自上涨趋势切换而来。 信号强度：微弱（评分 +0/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: minimal no clean setup (+14)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：微弱无明确形态（+14）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 ✗
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_knife_line: ⚠ Deep washout — price is 22% below its 200-day, a broken primary trend. Measured: setups this stretched below the 200-day held the cycle low only ~37% of the time and drew a ~−22% tail (violent bounces, rarely the durable low). Treat as knife-risk — wait for it to reclaim the 10-day average and size small. The score above is already tempered for this.
ladder.bc_knife_line_zh: ⚠ 深度超卖——价格较 200 日均线低约 22%（主趋势已破）。实测：如此远低于 200 日线的形态，仅约 37% 守住周期低点，且回撤尾部约 −22%（反弹猛烈，但很少是持久低点）。视为「接飞刀」风险——等其收复 10 日均线后再小仓参与。上方分数已据此打折。

caveats: Risk cone (drawdown/vol) is the validated read; DIRECTION is display-only (measured coin-flip).
Cone widens with horizon; downside tail is the forecastable left side.
Long per-name cone is thin/under-powered — defer to the sector cone.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: negative-gamma tape — dealer hedging amplifies the move (fuel for a breakout)
reasons.zh: 负 Gamma 行情 — 做市商对冲放大波动（利于突破）

reasons.en: short-gamma expansion — realized vol elevated, no suppressive band
reasons.zh: 空头 Gamma 扩张 — 已实现波动升高，无抑制带

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

trust_tier.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust_tier.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡
